description:
Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.


Moku is a fast, minimal manga reader frontend for Suwayomi-Server.

It wraps Suwayomi's GraphQL API in a lightweight Tauri app — no Electron overhead.
# Moku v0.14.0
**Released:** October 12, 2026
> "More novels, less waiting."

## Highlights
• **Tsundoku-format novel extensions**：novel extension repos built for Tsundoku can now be added, and their sources install and read like any other
• **Server-side automation**：library updates and automations now run on the Tsunagu backend, with an optional library update when the app opens
• **Pages for the novel reader**, along with a wider column width limit
• **Windows and Linux ARM64 builds**

## New Features
• Added support for Tsundoku-format novel extension repos
• Added server-side automation with library update on app open
• Added pages mode for the novel reader
• Added folder content types and type-aware extension counts
• Added backup controls
• Added extensions-lib 16 anime source support (hosters), thanks to @VictorCabral99
• Added a Moku PKGBUILD that bundles Tsunagu

## Improvements
• Widened the novel reader's column width limit
• Download progress for ffmpeg jobs is now based on stream duration
• Search errors from extensions are now reported instead of returning an empty page
• Manga page URLs now resolve with bounded concurrency
• Cleaned up FlareSolverr handling and added retries
• Covers now go through FlareSolverr, with extra configuration
• Updated dependencies and moved the backend to Gradle 9

## Bug Fixes
• Fixed the Flatpak build by moving to the GNOME 50 runtime
• Fixed Popular and Latest for suspend-API extensions
• Fixed WTR-LAB chapter decryption
• Fixed novel plugin compatibility and sandbox crash recovery
• Fixed origin 403s being mistaken for Cloudflare, and HLS streams hosted on ad CDNs
• Fixed segment streaming truncating oversized responses
• Fixed queued download jobs being claimed twice, and Cancel now waits for cleanup
• Fixed the MAL tracker callback when bound to loopback
• Fixed backup folder reveal and leaked blob URLs
• Fixed Rust toolchain bundling and the Nix flake

## Notes
• Backup controls are new and lightly tested, please report any issues
• Some novel sources sit behind Cloudflare and need FlareSolverr enabled
• WTR-LAB needs its decryption key set in the source settings
• Cloudflare/FlareSolverr support is functional but pending broader user testing
• Anime player upscaling is still work in progress and untested

## Contributors
• @VictorCabral99 added extensions-lib 16 anime hosters and download/streaming fixes in Tsunagu#6
• @kannachi323 fixed shared streaming and sources in Tsunagu#5

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/moku-project/Moku/compare/v0.13.1...v0.14.0
